nodes.label: LRN-001: Petdex Standardized Format 8×9 Grid 192×208px 9 States
nodes.rationale: Petdex grid is fixed 8 columns × 9 rows, 1536×1872px total, 192×208px per cell. Each row is a named animation state with a defined frame count. This fixed format enables auto-detection in the Core without a manual SpriteManifest.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-001: petdex standardized format 8×9 grid 192×208px 9 states

nodes.label: LRN-002: Petdex→Clawd State Mapping (6 of 9 states mapped)
nodes.rationale: 6 Petdex states map to Clawd on Desk states; run-right (row 1) and run-left (row 2) are silently ignored by the Clawd adapter. Mapping: idle→idle, thinking→waiting, working→running, error→failed, happy→waving, notification→review, sleeping→idle, waking→jumping.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-002: petdex→clawd state mapping (6 of 9 states mapped)

nodes.label: LRN-003: Petdex→Clawd Mapping is Provisional and Adjustable
nodes.rationale: The mapping table is a first approximation intended to be adjusted after real-pet terrain tests. Code should keep mapping in a config table, not dispersed hardcoded values.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-003: petdex→clawd mapping is provisional and adjustable

nodes.label: LRN-004: bmad-product-brief Short-Circuitable When RFC + Memory Present
nodes.rationale: When a project has a complete RFC and structured agent memory, stages 1-2 of the product-brief workflow (intent + contextual discovery) can be skipped to go directly to draft.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-004: bmad-product-brief short-circuitable when rfc + memory present

nodes.label: LRN-005: resolve_customization.py Unusable on Windows Without Python - Manual Fallback Sufficient
nodes.rationale: BMAD script resolve_customization.py fails silently on Windows when Python is absent from PATH. Reading customize.toml directly is an equivalent fallback when no override files exist.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-005: resolve_customization.py unusable on windows without python - manual fallback sufficient

nodes.label: LRN-006: BMAD PRD Multi-step Scope Duplication to Merge in Step-11
nodes.rationale: Steps 3 and 8 of bmad-create-prd produce overlapping Scope content. Step-11 polish must systematically audit and merge these into a single unified section (Product Scope & Roadmap).
nodes.norm_label: lrn-006: bmad prd multi-step scope duplication to merge in step-11

nodes.label: LRN-007: BMAD Step-04 Category Filtering for CLI Tools
nodes.rationale: For a pure CLI tool, the 5 generic BMAD step-04 decision categories (Data, Auth, API, Frontend, Infrastructure) should be replaced by 3 project-specific ones: (1) pipeline internal architecture, (2) public interface contract, (3) infra & distribution.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-007: bmad step-04 category filtering for cli tools

nodes.label: LRN-008: Check document_output_language Before bmad-epics-and-stories Step-03
nodes.rationale: BMAD generates stories in English by default if document_output_language is not controlled before step-03. Must verify config.yaml setting and apply the native language from the first story.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-008: check document_output_language before bmad-epics-and-stories step-03

nodes.label: LRN-009: CLI Tool Core Epic Without End-User Value is Acceptable Derogation
nodes.rationale: For a CLI tool with Core/CLI separation, the Core epic does not deliver standalone end-user value. BMAD flags this as a violation but it is an expected and acceptable derogation for this architecture pattern.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-009: cli tool core epic without end-user value is acceptable derogation

nodes.label: LRN-010: Coverage Map ≠ UX AC Coverage - Verify WHEN/HOW Not Just WHAT
nodes.rationale: A FR marked covered in the Coverage Map may have assigned stories with ACs too vague to describe the concrete UX flow. Must verify: (1) trigger condition, (2) interaction flow, (3) validation/error handling for each user-interaction FR.
nodes.norm_label: lrn-010: coverage map = ux ac coverage - verify when/how not just what
